name: LRCGET
description: LRCGET is a utility for mass-downloading synced LRC lyrics for your offline music library. This Unraid container runs the Linux desktop app inside a browser-accessible GUI container on port 5800. This is an unofficial Unraid container/template for LRCGET. Audio playback through the browser WebUI is enabled with WEB_AUDIO=1. Audio works through the browser WebUI on port 5800, not through VNC.

paths.name: Music
paths.description: Music library folder. Change this to your actual Unraid music path.

variables.name: USER_ID
variables.description: Container user ID. 99 is the default Unraid nobody user.

variables.name: GROUP_ID
variables.description: Container group ID. 100 is the default Unraid users group.

variables.name: WEB_AUDIO
variables.description: Enable browser-based audio streaming from the container WebUI. Audio works through port 5800, not VNC.

variables.name: APP_NICENESS
variables.description: Process niceness. Negative values require SYS_NICE capability, which is included in Extra Parameters.

variables.name: GDK_BACKEND
variables.description: GTK backend. Required for the browser GUI container.

variables.name: LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE
variables.description: Use software rendering to avoid black screen issues.

variables.name: WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER
variables.description: Disable WebKit DMABUF renderer to avoid black screen issues.

variables.name: WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE
variables.description: Disable WebKit compositing mode to avoid black screen issues.
